exposure: Shoulder dystocia in a previous pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consists of women who gave birth to term macrosomic infants at Tuen Mun Hospital between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2023.
finding: Antenatal detection of macrosomia is associated with a decrease in neonatal complications but an increase in maternal complications and Caesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: Antenatal detection of macrosomia was independently associated with a significantly increased rate of Caesarean delivery.
